raw_response:
I am thinking about this year like I always do — what did last year look like, what are my neighbors doing, how much money do I have for fertilizer and seed.

My land is 10.5 mu. My wife and I, that's all. At 71 my back is not what it was, so I keep things simple — what I know works.

**My plan for the land:**
I will put winter wheat on all 10.5 mu like always, sow in October after maize and millet come off. After wheat in June, I split the summer — about 7 mu for millet (our old rotation, millet does not need as much water and the price is good when dry years come), and 3.5 mu for maize because maize gives more kilograms and I can sell it easy.

**Wheat (winter):**
Last year I used 2 bags of compound fertilizer (that 15-15-15 one, 50 kg each bag) per mu as base before sowing, then 1 bag of urea per mu at green-up in spring. Wheat gave me around 450 kg/mu, not bad. I will do the same. Two bags compound = 15 kg N, 15 kg P, 15 kg K. Plus one bag urea (23 kg N). So about 23+15=38 kg N? No wait, that is too much — let me think. One bag compound 50kg × 15% = 7.5 kg. Two bags = 15 kg N. One bag urea 50kg × 46% = 23 kg N. Total around 25 kg N per mu because I do not use full bag of urea, maybe 40 kg. Neighbors do similar. I water 3 times — before winter, at green-up, at filling. My well works fine. Improved variety, the one the seed shop sells, I bought same kind last three years.

**Millet (summer):**
Millet is tough, does not ask for much. I put half a bag compound fertilizer per mu, maybe sprinkle some urea if rain is good. Water once or twice from well if dry. Millet last year gave 250 kg/mu. I use improved seed from the shop, not my old seed anymore — the new one fills better.

**Maize (summer):**
Maize eats more. I put 1.5 bags compound as base, then half a bag urea at big trumpet stage. Water 2 times. Hybrid seed — everyone buys hybrid now, you cannot grow the old kind and expect yield. Last year maize gave 500 kg/mu.

**Pesticide:**
Wheat I spray 2 times — aphids in spring, maybe one for rust. Millet 1 time for worms. Maize 1 time for borer. I do not spray extra if I do not see problems.

**Tillage:**
I rent the rotary tiller from village service, 40 yuan per mu. Too old to plow deep myself.
